claims.scope: Every pair of nonempty disjoint affine cosets in a physical Boolean cube, with arbitrary physical adjacency and arbitrary overlap of annihilator spectra
claims.statement: For the specified genuine Boolean selector splice, the signed associator Omega is at most 8 ln(2) times the physical influence of d.
If q physical coordinate directions join two disjoint affine cosets and ell=codim(V+W), then each active-coordinate count m_j is at least max(k_j,q+ell-1).
The common-annihilator collision of two disjoint affine cosets never increases raw spectral entropy.
